content.thinking: The SASS is identical across both builds, so the 2-8% slowdown comes purely from higher occupancy (12 CTAs/SM vs 10) hurting rather than helping. I'll test this directly by adding smem padding to force lower occupancy on both the row and pair kernels.

Occupancy sweep shows the row kernel degrades noticeably below 13 CTAs/SM while the pair kernel stays flat between 7-10 CTAs/SM, and padding with 11.5 KB caps the 40-reg build at 10 CTAs/SM to match the 48-reg probe. I'll apply that same padding to the pair path and re-test.
